input.content: Create the published track-repo-stars Routine now, with an interval Trigger named track-repo-stars-every-2m in its spec.triggers. It must fetch https://api.github.com/repos/tulipfarm/tulipfarm, read stargazers_count out of the response, and append a repo_stats record every 2 minutes. Do not use an Agent for any of it. Call soul_write once with definitionMode canonical. Do not ask me to confirm.

tools.name: soul_write
tools.description: Commit one Soul definition. Set definitionMode to canonical for canonical YAML.

arguments.content:
apiVersion: tulipfarm.ai/v1
kind: Routine
metadata:
  id: 33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333
  slug: track-repo-stars
  schemaVersion: 1
  authoredVersion: 1
  lifecycle: published
spec:
  owner: ops-team
  start: Fetch
  states:
    - type: action
      name: Fetch
      action: api_request
      input:
        method: GET
        url: https://api.github.com/repos/tulipfarm/tulipfarm
      transition: Extract
    - type: script
      name: Extract
      script: "({ run(ctx, input) { return { stars: JSON.parse(input.body).stargazers_count }; } })"
      input:
        body: "${ states.Fetch.output.body }"
      transition: Save
    - type: action
      name: Save
      action: record_create
      input:
        type: repo_stats
        data:
          stars: "${ states.Extract.output.stars }"
      end: true
  triggers:
    - name: track-repo-stars-every-2m
      type: interval
      everyMs: 120000
      schedule:
        missedRunPolicy: skip
        overlapPolicy: skip
      eventType: routine.scheduled
      eventVersion: 1
      backgroundIdentity:
        principalKind: service
        principalId: routine-runner
      deduplication:
        key: track-repo-stars-every-2m

script.text: I created track-repo-stars. It calls api_request, parses the body in a script State, and appends a repo_stats record every 2 minutes. No Agent runs in it.

input.content: Does the track-repo-stars Routine use an Agent anywhere?

script.text: No Agent runs in track-repo-stars. Every State is deterministic: api_request, then a script State, then record_create.
